# Pot shard

Type: Material | Internal ID: Pot_Shard_Green | Source: Ancient pot | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Pot shard is an item found by destroying Ancient pots inside Putrid Hole or Charred Ruins.

### Building

• Small green pot
• Medium green pot
• Large green pot

## Trivia

• An alternative Pot_Shard_Red is coded, but only the green version is dropped by Ancient pot.
